purpose: Photographic hero-image assignment for Vend-R place/seller pages. These are presentation categories, not canonical lore claims.

rules.deterministic_assignment: Pick from visual_family image pool using a stable hash of entity_id unless image_override is set.
rules.no_random_reload: The same entity must keep the same image across reloads.
rules.crop_metadata: Store focal_x/focal_y per image so wide title strips can crop safely.
rules.terminology: visual_condition and visual_setting guide image selection only; they are not canonical facts about the location.
rules.image_pool_key: Optional narrower photographic pool. This may differ from visual_family where semantic specificity matters.

street-storefront.label: Street storefront
street-storefront.description: Independent or chain retail frontage/counter: convenience stores, specialist shops, ordinary city retail.

food-retail.label: Food retail
food-retail.description: Grocers, butchers, bakeries and food-led shops where counters, shelves or produce define the space.

market-stall.label: Market stall
market-stall.description: Temporary, open-fronted or table-based retail: night markets, street stalls, pop-ups and compact booths.

market-complex.label: Market complex
market-complex.description: Larger multi-vendor markets, malls, container markets and enclosed trading complexes.

secondhand-clutter.label: Second-hand / clutter
secondhand-clutter.description: Pawn, salvage, antiques, used goods and dense second-hand retail with visibly accumulated stock.

showroom-boutique.label: Showroom / boutique
showroom-boutique.description: Polished, curated or premium retail: fashion, branded showrooms, luxury goods and presentation-led sales.

workshop-garage.label: Workshop / garage
workshop-garage.description: Repair benches, fabrication spaces, garages, technical workshops and back-of-house trade environments.

clinic-pharmacy.label: Clinic / pharmacy
clinic-pharmacy.description: Medical counters, treatment rooms, pharmacies and body-modification spaces.

hospitality-interior.label: Hospitality interior
hospitality-interior.description: Bars, cafés, restaurants, clubs and other businesses where sitting, eating, drinking or socialising define the space.

large-complex.label: Large complex
large-complex.description: Megabuildings, residences, campuses and other large parent places that contain commerce without being a shop floor themselves.

outdoor-camp.label: Outdoor / camp
outdoor-camp.description: Nomad camps, farms, parks and outdoor trading environments.

office-service.label: Office / institutional service
office-service.description: Headquarters, offices, stations and service locations where desks, reception or institutional interiors are more appropriate than retail.
